about.title: About Us
about.intro: Rothern is a Turkey-based B2B sourcing marketplace that brings buyer and supplier companies together in one account. On Rothern, companies publish product showcases, post buying requests, collect sealed-bid quotes, negotiate, award, and follow the order through to delivery from a single panel.
about.what1: Industrial purchasing still runs largely on email, phone and Excel: the buyer pulls the supplier list out of their own notebook, compares quotes by hand, and there is no single place showing who quoted what and when. Rothern moves this flow into one panel — from posting the request to delivering the order, every step lives on the same record, and who did what and when stays auditable.
about.what2: On the supplier side the issue is visibility: a company listing its products can quote on a request posted by a buyer that has never heard of it. Matching is built on a four-level international category tree and the activity types companies declare.
about.oneAccountBody: A company is usually both a buyer and a seller. On Rothern a single company account opens both panels: on the buying side you post requests and collect quotes; on the selling side you quote on others' requests and manage your product showcase. What each team member can do on each side is set separately in a permission table; you can define a manager who only approves, a viewer who cannot quote, or a salesperson who works only on the selling side.
about.p1Body: Bidders cannot see each other's quotes; not even the NUMBER of quotes is published. A “how many quotes” counter that makes competition visible is a pressure tool for driving prices down — so there isn't one.
about.p2Title: The buyer's identity belongs to the buyer.
about.p2Body: Public request pages do not show the buyer company's name: what you are looking for should not tell your competitors about your production plans. What is visible is attributes, not identity — city, country, industry, activity type.
about.p3Body: Creating a profile, appearing in the directory and publishing products cost nothing. Paid plans buy priority, not visibility itself: ranking, unlimited products, documents and video, access to public requests.
about.p4Body: We show nothing we haven't measured. Counters like “40 suppliers viewed this product” do not appear on the site unless there is a real measurement behind them; if a field is empty, it looks empty.
about.noIntermediationBody: The only thing sold through Rothern is membership plans. The platform does not intermediate the value of goods and services between companies and does not carry money; contracts and payments run directly between the parties. The payment steps on the order screen are a record of the notifications the parties make to each other.
about.whoBody: Company registrations are currently accepted from Turkey, Northern Cyprus, Russia, Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, China and the United Arab Emirates. Each country has its own document set; verification is done by a person without exception, and there is no automatic approval path. See the <faq>frequently asked questions</faq> and <how>How It Works</how> pages for details.

g1.heading: Platform
g1.a1: Rothern is a Turkey-based B2B sourcing marketplace that brings buyer and supplier companies together in one account. Companies publish product showcases, post buying requests, collect sealed-bid quotes and turn the winning quote into an order. The same company account works on both the buying and selling side; there is no need to open two accounts.
g1.a2: No. The only thing sold through Rothern is membership plans. The platform does not intermediate the value of goods and services between companies and does not carry money; trade runs directly between the parties. The payment steps on the order screen are notifications the parties make to each other.
g1.a3: Turkey, Northern Cyprus, Russia, Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, China and the United Arab Emirates. Each country has its own document set; in China, for example, the 营业执照 (business licence) carries registry, tax and representative details in one document, so no separate tax document is requested.

g2.heading: Quotes and confidentiality
g2.a1: Yes, quotes are collected as sealed bids. Bidders can never see each other's quotes, and the NUMBER of quotes is not published either. Only the company that posted the request sees the quotes it receives. A submitted quote cannot be edited or withdrawn — if the buyer eliminates it, the supplier can submit a new version.
g2.q2: Why isn't the name of the company that posted the request visible?
g2.a2: In a buying request, “who is buying” is direct competitive intelligence: a company looking for 40 tons of steel pipe reveals its production plan. That is why public request pages do not show the buyer's name, logo or profile link. What is visible is attributes, not identity: city, country, industry, activity type and the “Verified buyer” badge. The buyer's identity is disclosed to the other party during the quote process.
g2.q3: What do I need to quote on a request?
g2.a3: You can quote on a request from a company that invited you or is connected to you with a free account and without document verification — the buyer already knows you. Quoting on a public request from a company that doesn't know you requires the Silver plan and company verification; since the platform is what brings you in, the platform vouches for you.

g3.heading: Products and prices
g3.a1: Yes. With the free Standard membership you can create a company profile, appear in the directory and publish up to ten products. What paid plans add is standing out, not being visible: priority ranking in the directory, unlimited products, product documents and video, the “Verified” badge and access to public requests.
g3.q2: Why do some products have no price?
g3.a2: A price can take three forms: a fixed price, tiered pricing by quantity, or “request a quote”. The third is not missing data but the seller's deliberate choice, and the platform does not penalise it — otherwise sellers would type an unreal price just to fill the field. Prices exclude VAT and are the seller's declaration.
g3.a3: It means the company's documents covering its trade registry, tax and authorised-person details were reviewed and accepted by Rothern. Verification is done by a person without exception; there is no automatic approval path. The badge concerns the company's identity — it is not a statement about product or service quality.
g3.a4: A four-level international category tree (segment / family / class / commodity) is used; the source is Ariba's UNSPSC-based catalog with more than 158,000 codes. Requests and products are opened with at least a third-level code, so buyer and supplier match in the same language.

g4.heading: Account and data
g4.q1: Do I wait for approval to register?
g4.a1: No. The account works immediately after email verification and a short setup step. Admin approval is only needed for document verification (KYC), and even that is required only where the platform vouches for you rather than for every action: quoting on a public request, publishing a request and awarding.
g4.q2: Can several people from my team use the same account?
g4.a2: Yes. Users are invited to the company account and each person's permissions are set separately in a permission table: buying, selling, approval and administration. Every person who acts on the buying or selling side uses a “seat”; the number of seats depends on the plan. People who only view or approve do not use a seat.
g4.q3: What happens to my personal data?
g4.a3: Rothern is the data controller under Turkish data protection law (KVKK). The notice and privacy policy are in the agreements section at the bottom of the site; you can send requests to {kvkkEmail}. You choose which fields of the company profile are public; contact details are shown only to registered members, not to visitors.

faq.q1: Do buyers and suppliers register separately?
faq.a1: No. Rothern has a single company account; the same account both buys and sells. The roles you assign to people (buying / selling) determine what they can see and do.
faq.q2: Can suppliers see each other's quotes?
faq.a2: Never. Sealed bids: each supplier sees only its own quote. The request owner sees all quotes and awards the best one.
faq.q3: What can I do with the Standard membership?
faq.a3: You publish your profile, open a showcase of up to {n} products, discover companies, and quote on requests from companies that invited you or are connected to you. Seeing and quoting on public requests, sending connection invitations, seeing the buyer's identity in incoming inquiries and replying, and the “Verified” badge come with Silver; posting your own buying requests comes with Gold.
faq.a4: No. Payment is made directly between the parties; Rothern does not handle money. Payment is only marked as “paid” or “payment pending”. There is no per-seat fee.
faq.a5: The order is created the moment the award is made. You follow the shipping and delivery steps in the panel and mark the payment as “paid”; payment is made between the parties.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Only you can see it. Our team reviews it once you submit it for review.

pending.label: Pending review
pending.description: Our team is reviewing it — usually within 1 business day. Until the review is complete the product cannot be edited, only previewed; once approved it goes to the showcase, and if changes are needed it comes back to you with the reason.

published.label: Published
published.description: In the showcase and open to search engines. Content changes go through review again; the product stays published in the meantime.

published_pending.label: Published · under review
published_pending.description: Your latest change is under review; the product stays in the showcase in the meantime. No further changes can be made until the review is complete.

rejected.label: Changes requested
rejected.description: Our team has requested changes. Make the change described in the reason and submit for review again.
